newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel gains to be thwarted at 129.78.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel gains to be thwarted at 129.78.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF were likely to find any gains capped by the 129.78/80 resistance area on Monday, technical analysts said.
Much of the upward technical pressure is likely to be spent over the next few sessions, and losses loom longer term.

"It wants to push higher towards the resistance at 129.78, the reaction high after the steep decline and then 129.80," said Howard Friend, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London. "The last few days have seen higher lows.
September notionnel futures were down 0.04 at 129.50 by 0750 GMT.
Above 129.78, technical analysts at Chase in London said in a research note that a break above 130.34 would trigger an Elliott buy signal, but trendline resistance at 130.56 should cause a setback
The 130.34 level was the low formed on July 25 between the peaks of 131.24 and 131.14.
In the short term, the 129.78 to 129.18 range is likely to hold sway, Friend said, with a break through the bottom more likely than a defeat of the top.
"I expect a failure near 130.00 before a more bearish trend resumes," he said.
He said the August 13 reaction low at 129.18 was steady support, and once that level gives way then levels below 129.00 come into play.
"The market based out around 128.94," said Friend. "If it takes that out then 128.50 is next."
Notionnel set daily lows at 128.94 on August 11 and 128.96 on August 6.
At the short end, September Pibor futures were up one basis point at 96.50. Resistance at 96.51, the August 13 and 14 high was holding firm.
